<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en"><head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>Flame Head â€” One spark away from extraordinary</title>
<meta name="description" content="Flame Head is a design studio from Kerala, India. Brands, ideas and everything in between.">

<style>
@font-face{font-family:"LT Wave UI";src:url(FONT_DATA_REMOVED) format("woff2");font-weight:300 700;font-style:normal;font-display:swap}
@font-face{font-family:"LT Wave Mono";src:url(FONT_DATA_REMOVED) format("woff2");font-weight:400 700;font-style:normal;font-display:swap}
@font-face{font-family:"LT Wave";src:url(FONT_DATA_REMOVED) format("woff2");font-weight:300;font-style:normal;font-display:swap}
@font-face{font-family:"LT Wave";src:url(FONT_DATA_REMOVED) format("woff2");font-weight:300;font-style:italic;font-display:swap}
@font-face{font-family:"LT Wave";src:url(FONT_DATA_REMOVED) format("woff2");font-weight:400 500;font-style:normal;font-display:swap}
@font-face{font-family:"LT Wave";src:url(FONT_DATA_REMOVED) format("woff2");font-weight:400 500;font-style:italic;font-display:swap}
@font-face{font-family:"LT Wave";src:url(FONT_DATA_REMOVED) format("woff2");font-weight:600 700;font-style:normal;font-display:swap}
@font-face{font-family:"LT Wave";src:url(FONT_DATA_REMOVED) format("woff2");font-weight:600 700;font-style:italic;font-display:swap}
:root{--primary:#E5372A;--link:#F36F21;--amber:#FDA83A;--canvas:#141414;--ink:#FFF4E8;--body:#C2B8AD;--muted:#827970;--faint:#262220;--hairline:#2A2522;
--flame:linear-gradient(135deg,#FDA83A 0%,#F36F21 48%,#E5372A 100%);--glow:0 0 24px rgba(229,55,42,.4);--px:16px;
--title:"LT Wave UI",Lexend,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",Roboto,sans-serif;
--text:"LT Wave",Outfit,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",Roboto,sans-serif;
--label:"LT Wave Mono","Space Mono","SF Mono","Courier New",monospace;--ease:180ms ease-out}
@media(min-width:768px){:root{--px:20px}}@media(min-width:1024px){:root{--px:44px}}@media(min-width:1280px){:root{--px:76px}}
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0}html{scroll-behavior:smooth;background:var(--canvas)}
body{font:400 16px/1.5 var(--text);color:var(--ink);background:var(--canvas);-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;overflow-x:hidden}
a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}img,svg{display:block;max-width:100%}
:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--amber);outline-offset:3px}
.wrap{max-width:1920px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 var(--px);position:relative}
.mono{font-family:var(--label);font-size:12px;line-height:1.55}
.disp{font-family:var(--title);font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.04em;line-height:.95}
.lab{display:flex;gap:20px;align-items:baseline;font:400 16px/1.55 var(--label)}.lab b{font-weight:400;color:var(--primary)}
.rule{border-top:1px solid rgba(255,244,232,.28)}.light .rule{border-color:#c9bfb4}
/* buttons */
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:10px;height:56px;padding:0 24px;border:0;border-radius:0;cursor:pointer;font:500 16px/1.55 var(--label);transition:transform var(--ease),background-color var(--ease),color var(--ease),border-color var(--ease)}
.btn-p{background:var(--primary);color:var(--ink);box-shadow:var(--glow)}.btn-p:hover{background:var(--link);transform:translateY(-2px)}
.btn-o{background:transparent;color:var(--ink);border:1px solid rgba(255,244,232,.8);height:55px}.btn-o:hover{border-color:var(--link);color:var(--link);transform:translate(2px,-2px)}
.light .btn-o{color:var(--canvas);border-color:var(--canvas)}.light .btn-o:hover{color:var(--primary);border-color:var(--primary)}
.btn-l{background:var(--link);color:var(--canvas);border:1px solid #fff;height:48px;font-size:16px}.btn-l:hover{background:var(--amber);transform:translateY(-2px)}
.ph{background:#c8d1d9;color:var(--canvas);display:grid;place-items:center;font:400 16px var(--label);aspect-ratio:1;transition:transform var(--ease)}
/* header */
header{height:96px}header .wrap{height:96px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:20px}@media(min-width:1280px){header .wrap{padding:0 29px 0 25px}}
header .wrap:after{content:"";position:absolute;left:var(--px);right:var(--px);bottom:0;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,244,232,.28)}
.logo{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:26px}.logo img{width:50px;height:auto}.logo svg{width:170px;height:auto;fill:var(--ink)}
.hr{margin-left:auto;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:24px}.clock{font:400 16px/1.4 var(--label);color:var(--body);display:none}
.hr .btn{height:48px;padding:0 14px;font-size:15px}@media(min-width:1024px){.hr .btn{min-width:212px}}
.burger{width:46px;height:46px;background:none;border:0;cursor:pointer;display:grid;align-content:center;gap:9px;padding:0}.burger i{height:3px;background:var(--ink);transition:transform var(--ease)}
.burger.on i:nth-child(1){transform:translateY(12px) rotate(45deg)}.burger.on i:nth-child(2){opacity:0}.burger.on i:nth-child(3){transform:translateY(-12px) rotate(-45deg)}
.menu{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:50;background:var(--canvas);display:none;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;gap:16px;padding:96px var(--px) 40px}
.menu.on{display:flex}.menu a{font:400 44px/1.2 var(--title);letter-spacing:-.045em;color:var(--link);transition:transform var(--ease),color var(--ease)}.menu a:hover{color:var(--amber);transform:translateX(8px)}
.burger{position:relative;z-index:60}
@media(min-width:768px){.clock{display:block}}
/* hero */
.hero .wrap{display:grid;gap:40px;padding-top:56px}
.hero{background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(255,244,232,.12) 1px,rgba(20,20,20,0) 1.5px) 0 0/28px 28px,var(--canvas)}
.hero h1{font-size:clamp(44px,6vw,82px);display:grid;line-height:.75}.hero h1 span{text-align:right}@media(min-width:1024px){.hero .wrap{column-gap:0}.hero h1 span{white-space:nowrap}}.hero .copy{width:fit-content;max-width:100%}.hero .tag{text-align:left}.hero h1 em{font-style:normal;color:var(--amber)}
.tag{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:center;font:400 22px/1.3 var(--text);margin-top:10px}.tag:before{content:"";width:13px;height:13px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--link);flex:none}
.hero .ph{width:min(230px,60vw);justify-self:center;will-change:transform}
.hero p.lead{font:300 22px/1.4 var(--text);letter-spacing:-.02em}.cta{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:20px 40px;margin-top:32px;justify-content:space-between}@media(min-width:1024px){.cta{flex-wrap:nowrap}.cta .btn{padding:0 14px;height:55px}}
.hero .lab{padding:20px 0 20px;margin-top:20px}
@media(min-width:1024px){.hero .wrap{grid-template-columns:1fr 37%;grid-template-rows:auto 1fr auto;min-height:672px;padding-top:0}.hero .ph{grid-column:2;grid-row:1;margin:117px 0 0 0;justify-self:center;width:230px}
.hero .copy{grid-column:1;grid-row:1/3;align-self:center}.hero .side{grid-column:2;grid-row:2;align-self:end}.hero .lab{grid-column:1/3}.hero .lab{border-top:1px solid rgba(255,244,232,.28)}}
/* intro */
.light{background:var(--ink);color:var(--canvas)}
.intro .lab{padding:42px 0 14px;border-bottom:1px solid #c9bfb4;margin:0}.intro .lab span{color:var(--canvas)}
.intro .grid{display:grid;gap:40px;padding:32px 0 36px}
.intro h2,.intro p{font:400 clamp(22px,2.35vw,32px)/1.45 var(--text);letter-spacing:-.01em}.intro h2{color:var(--link);font-weight:600}
.intro .meta b{display:block;font:600 18px/1.4 var(--text);margin-top:10px}.intro .meta span{font:400 15px/1.5 var(--label);display:block}
.intro .row{display:flex;gap:28px;flex-wrap:wrap;padding-top:36px;border-top:1px solid #c9bfb4}.intro .row .btn{height:56px}
.intro .bot{display:grid;gap:28px;padding:30px 0 64px;border-top:1px solid #c9bfb4}.intro .meta{max-width:270px}
@media(min-width:1024px){.intro .grid{grid-template-columns:49% 1fr;padding-top:60px}.intro .ph{width:230px;margin:0 0 0 109px;align-self:center}.intro .bot{grid-template-columns:49% 1fr;padding-bottom:76px}.intro .grid{padding-bottom:70px;border-bottom:0}.intro .grid+.bot{}}
/* process */
.proc{height:340vh;background:var(--canvas);position:relative}.proc .st{position:sticky;top:0;min-height:100vh;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.proc .wrap{width:100%;flex:1;display:grid;gap:28px;padding-top:56px;padding-bottom:20px;align-content:start}
.stepn{font:400 14px/1.5 var(--label);display:flex;gap:6px;color:var(--muted);transition:color var(--ease)}.stepn b{font-weight:400}
.step.on .stepn{color:var(--ink)}.step.on .stepn b{color:var(--amber)}.step p{font:400 24px/1.35 var(--text);letter-spacing:-.02em;max-width:460px;display:none;margin-top:8px}.step.on p{display:block}
.step{margin-bottom:6px}.step:not(.on) .stepn{font-size:14px;color:var(--body)}
.words{line-height:1;display:grid;font-family:var(--title);font-weight:600;font-size:clamp(34px,4.7vw,64px);letter-spacing:-.04em;line-height:1.05;margin-top:48px;gap:6px}
.words span:nth-child(1){color:var(--amber);padding-left:25px}.words span:nth-child(2){padding-left:14.4vw;font:400 clamp(28px,3.2vw,44px)/1.2 var(--text);letter-spacing:-.02em}.words span:nth-child(3){color:var(--primary);padding-left:14.7vw}
.frame .strip{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font:400 16px/1.55 var(--label);color:var(--body);margin-bottom:6px}
.frame .ph{aspect-ratio:1.26;width:100%;transition:opacity var(--ease)}
.proc .lab{justify-content:flex-end;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,244,232,.2);padding:24px 0 28px;margin-top:auto}@media(min-width:1024px){.proc .lab{grid-column:1/-1;grid-row:3}}
@media(min-width:1024px){.proc .wrap{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;grid-template-rows:auto 1fr}.frame{grid-column:2;grid-row:1/3;align-self:end;margin-bottom:56px;margin-top:100px;width:30.5vw;justify-self:end;margin-right:calc((var(--px) - 19px)*-1)}.words{grid-column:1;align-self:end;margin-bottom:56px}}
/* showcase */
.show{background:var(--amber);color:var(--canvas);position:relative;overflow:hidden;transition:background-position .1s linear;background-size:100% 300%;background-image:linear-gradient(180deg,#FDA83A 0%,#F89A33 35%,#F36F21 70%,#FDA83A 100%);background-position:0 calc(var(--sp,0)*100%)}
.show .wrap{min-height:606px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between;padding-top:150px;padding-bottom:36px;gap:60px}
.show h2{font-size:clamp(44px,6vw,82px);color:var(--primary);text-transform:uppercase}
.show p{font:600 clamp(22px,2.6vw,36px)/1.4 var(--text);letter-spacing:-.02em;text-align:right;max-width:700px;align-self:flex-end}
.show svg{align-self:center;fill:var(--canvas);animation:bob 1.6s ease-in-out infinite}@keyframes bob{50%{transform:translateY(6px)}}
.brands{height:420vh;position:relative}.brands .st{position:sticky;top:0;height:100vh;min-height:640px;overflow:hidden;background:#3a352f}
.brands .bg{position:absolute;inset:-4%;background:url(data:image/jpeg;base64,) center/cover;transition:transform .2s linear}
.brands .st:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:rgba(20,20,20,.8);z-index:1}
.brands .wrap{position:relative;z-index:2;height:100%;display:grid;grid-template-rows:auto 1fr auto;padding-top:36px;padding-bottom:30px}
.idx{position:absolute;left:35px;top:42px;z-index:3;display:grid;gap:2px;font:400 16px/1.4 var(--label);color:#b5aca2;align-content:start}.idx button{all:unset;cursor:pointer;display:flex;gap:10px;transition:transform var(--ease),color var(--ease)}
.idx button b{font-weight:400}.idx button.on{color:var(--ink);transform:translateX(8px)}.idx button.on b{color:var(--amber)}
.slide{position:absolute;inset:0;display:block;opacity:0;transform:translateY(40px);transition:opacity .5s ease-out,transform .5s ease-out;pointer-events:none}.slide.on{opacity:1;transform:none;pointer-events:auto}
.slides{position:relative}.slide .logo2{position:absolute;top:50px;right:0;font:600 clamp(30px,3.2vw,44px)/1 var(--title);letter-spacing:-.04em;text-transform:uppercase}
.slide .info{position:absolute;top:288px;left:0;right:0;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-end;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:20px}
.slide h3{font:600 clamp(28px,3vw,40px)/1.2 var(--text);letter-spacing:-.03em}.slide h3+p{font:400 clamp(20px,2.2vw,28px)/1.3 var(--text);letter-spacing:-.02em}
.slide .pc{font:400 20px/1.55 var(--label);letter-spacing:-.02em;text-align:right}
.exp{position:absolute;right:0;bottom:0;overflow:hidden;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;height:64px;padding:0 32px;border:1px solid var(--primary);font:400 16px var(--label);cursor:pointer}
.exp:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:var(--primary);transform:scaleX(0);transform-origin:left;transition:transform .25s ease-out;z-index:-1}.exp:hover:before{transform:scaleX(1)}.exp{isolation:isolate}
.brands .lab{margin-top:18px}.btm{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-end}.btm .lab{align-self:flex-start;width:100%}
/* services */
.serv .lab{padding:36px 0 18px;border-bottom:1px solid #c9bfb4}.serv .lab span{color:var(--canvas)}
.serv .sub{font:600 clamp(22px,2.4vw,32px)/1.3 var(--text);letter-spacing:-.03em;text-align:right;padding:12px 0 0}
.sv{padding:150px 0 0;min-height:420px;transition:opacity .35s,transform .35s}.sv.out{opacity:0;transform:translateY(14px)}
.sv .n{font:400 16px var(--label);color:var(--primary)}.sv h2{font-size:clamp(44px,6vw,82px);letter-spacing:-.045em;line-height:1.1;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:600}.sv h2 em{font-style:normal;color:var(--primary)}
.sv p{font:600 clamp(18px,1.9vw,26px)/1.4 var(--text);letter-spacing:-.02em;margin-top:6px}
.serv .foot{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-end;gap:24px;flex-wrap:wrap;padding:10px 0 70px}
.serv .foot p{font:400 16px/1.55 var(--label);max-width:560px}
/* contact */
.touch{background:#000;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.touch:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:-30%;background:radial-gradient(40% 40% at 25% 70%,rgba(243,111,33,.32),transparent 70%),radial-gradient(35% 35% at 75% 30%,rgba(229,55,42,.28),transparent 70%),radial-gradient(30% 30% at 55% 85%,rgba(253,168,58,.16),transparent 70%);animation:drift 14s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
@keyframes drift{to{transform:translate(8%,-6%) scale(1.15)}}
.touch .wrap{padding-top:90px;padding-bottom:36px;display:grid;gap:44px}
.touch h2{font-size:clamp(44px,6vw,82px);text-transform:uppercase}.touch h2 em{font-style:normal;color:var(--primary);text-transform:none}
.touch h2+p{font:600 clamp(22px,2.6vw,34px)/1.2 var(--title);letter-spacing:-.04em;margin-top:8px}
.touch .r{display:grid;gap:28px;justify-items:end;text-align:right;align-content:end}.touch .r h3{font:600 clamp(26px,3vw,40px)/1.2 var(--text);letter-spacing:-.03em}
.touch .mail{font:400 clamp(26px,3.3vw,44px)/1.2 var(--text);letter-spacing:-.03em;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,244,232,.18);padding-top:34px;width:100%;margin-top:30px;transition:transform var(--ease)}.mail em{font-style:normal;color:var(--amber)}.mail:hover{transform:translateX(-8px)}
.touch nav{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px 30px;justify-content:flex-end;font:400 clamp(18px,1.8vw,24px)/1.35 var(--text);letter-spacing:-.03em}.touch nav a:hover,.fl a:hover{color:var(--amber)}
.touch .big{display:grid;gap:18px;align-content:end}.touch .big img{width:min(232px,50vw)}.touch .big svg{width:min(251px,60vw);fill:var(--ink)}
.fl{display:flex;gap:24px;align-items:center;font:400 16px var(--label);padding-top:44px}.fl .top{color:var(--primary);margin-left:36px}.fl .top:hover{color:var(--link)}
.touch .wrap>*{position:relative;z-index:1}
@media(min-width:1024px){.touch .wrap{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;grid-template-rows:auto 1fr}.touch .hd{grid-column:1/3}.touch .r{margin-top:100px}.touch .big{align-self:end;margin-top:-20px}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*,*:before{animation:none!important;transition:none!important}html{scroll-behavior:auto}}
</style></head><body>

<main>
<section class="hero"><div class="wrap">
<div class="copy"><h1 class="disp"><span>one spark away</span><span>from <em>extraordinary</em></span></h1><div class="tag">Giving ideas a look, a voice and a life of their own.</div></div>
<div class="ph" id="tilt" aria-hidden="true">placeholder</div>
<div class="side"><p class="lead">Flame Head is a design studio from Kerala, India. We are your design solution for brands, ideas and everything in between.</p>
<div class="cta"><a class="btn btn-p" href="#showcase">View our works</a><a class="btn btn-o" href="#contact">Kickstart your idea</a></div></div>

<section class="intro light" id="about"><div class="wrap">
<div class="lab"><b>01</b><span>&lt;introduction&gt;</span></div>
<div class="grid"><div class="ph" aria-hidden="true">placeholder</div>
<div><h2>Not every spark needs a matchstick.</h2><p>Sometimes, all it needs is a good idea and someone willing to run with it.<br>That's where we come in. We work with people and businesses to give their ideas a visual identity, a little personality and a reason to be remembered.</p></div></div>
<div class="row" style="display:none"></div>
<div class="bot"><div class="meta"><b>Based in</b><span>Kerala, India</span><b>Powered by</b><span>Pixels, possibilities and plenty of brainstorming.</span></div>
<div class="row" style="border:0;padding:0;align-self:start"><a class="btn btn-o" href="#about">About Flame Head</a><a class="btn btn-o" href="#services">Services</a></div></div>
</div></section>

<section class="proc" id="process"><div class="st"><div class="wrap">
<div class="steps">
<div class="step on" data-w="Listen|Understand|Define"><div class="stepn"><b>01</b>/Discover</div><p>Every project begins somewhere. We start by understanding the idea, the people behind it and what you're hoping to achieve.</p></div>
<div class="step" data-w="Research|Compare|Imagine"><div class="stepn"><b>02</b>/Explore</div><p>We dig into the space around your idea, look at what's out there and sketch the directions worth chasing.</p></div>
<div class="step" data-w="Sketch|Design|Build"><div class="stepn"><b>03</b>/Create</div><p>Ideas become visuals. We shape the identity, the system and every detail that gives it a voice.</p></div>
<div class="step" data-w="Review|Polish|Deliver"><div class="stepn"><b>04</b>/Refine</div><p>We sharpen, test and tidy until it's ready to go out into the world and stay memorable.</p></div></div>
<div class="words"><span>spark</span><span>to</span><span>shape</span></div>

<script>
const $=s=>document.querySelector(s),$$=s=>[...document.querySelectorAll(s)],R=matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce)').matches;
const clamp=v=>Math.min(1,Math.max(0,v)),prog=el=>{const r=el.getBoundingClientRect();return clamp(-r.top/Math.max(1,r.height-innerHeight))};
// clock (Kochi, IST)
const tick=()=>{try{$('#clock').innerHTML=new Date().toLocaleTimeString('en-GB',{hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit',timeZone:'Asia/Kolkata'})+'<br>Kochi'}catch(e){}};tick();setInterval(tick,3e4);
// menu
const bg=$('#bg'),menu=$('#menu');const tog=o=>{menu.classList.toggle('on',o);bg.classList.toggle('on',o);bg.setAttribute('aria-expanded',o)};
bg.onclick=()=>tog(!menu.classList.contains('on'));menu.onclick=e=>{if(e.target.tagName=='A')tog(false)};addEventListener('keydown',e=>e.key=='Escape'&&tog(false));
// hero placeholder tilt
const t=$('#tilt');if(t&&!R)$('.hero').addEventListener('pointermove',e=>{const r=t.getBoundingClientRect(),x=(e.clientX-r.left-r.width/2)/innerWidth,y=(e.clientY-r.top-r.height/2)/innerHeight;t.style.transform=`perspective(700px) rotateY(${x*24}deg) rotateX(${-y*24}deg)`});
// brands
const B=[['Brand A'],['Brand B'],['Brand C'],['Brand D']];
$('#idx').innerHTML=B.map((b,i)=>`<button data-i="${i}"><b>0${i+1}</b>/${b[0]}</button>`).join('');
$('#slides').innerHTML=B.map(b=>`<div class="slide"><div class="logo2">Brand Logo</div><div class="info"><div><h3>${b[0].replace('Brand ','Brand Name ')}</h3><p>&lt;short project description&gt;</p></div><div class="pc">Project category: &lt;&gt;</div></div></div>`).join('')+'';
$$('.slide').forEach(s=>{s.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend','<a class="exp" href="#showcase">Explore &lt;brand&gt; â†—</a>');s.style.gridTemplateRows=''});
const bs=$('.brands');let bi=-1;const setB=i=>{if(i==bi)return;bi=i;$$('.slide').forEach((s,k)=>s.classList.toggle('on',k==i));$$('#idx button').forEach((b,k)=>b.classList.toggle('on',k==i))};setB(0);
$$('#idx button').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{const i=+b.dataset.i;scrollTo({top:bs.offsetTop+(bs.offsetHeight-innerHeight)*(i+.5)/B.length,behavior:'smooth'})});
// process
const P=$('#process'),steps=$$('.step');let pi=-1;
const setP=i=>{if(i==pi)return;pi=i;steps.forEach((s,k)=>s.classList.toggle('on',k==i));const w=steps[i].dataset.w.split('|');$('#strip').innerHTML=w.map(x=>`<span>${x}</span>`).join('');const f=$('#pf');f.style.opacity=.4;setTimeout(()=>f.style.opacity=1,120)};
steps.forEach((s,i)=>s.onclick=()=>setP(i));
// scroll loop
const SH=$('.show');let q=0;const onS=()=>{q=0;setP(Math.min(3,Math.floor(prog(P)*4)));setB(Math.min(3,Math.floor(prog(bs)*4)));
const r=SH.getBoundingClientRect();SH.style.setProperty('--sp',clamp((innerHeight-r.top)/(innerHeight+r.height)).toFixed(3));$('#sand').style.transform=`translateY(${(prog(bs)-.5)*-40}px) scale(1.05)`};
addEventListener('scroll',()=>q||(q=requestAnimationFrame(onS)),{passive:true});addEventListener('resize',onS);onS();
// services loop
const S=[['Brand','Identity','Give your brand a face worth remembering.'],['Logo','& Marks','A small shape that carries a big idea.'],['Web','& Interface','Digital spaces that feel as good as they look.'],['Print','& Packaging','Things people can hold, keep and talk about.']];
let si=0;const sv=$('#sv'),draw=()=>{const s=S[si];$('#svn').textContent='0'+(si+1);$('#svt').innerHTML=`${s[0]} <em>${s[1]}</em>`;$('#svd').textContent=s[2]};draw();
if(!R)setInterval(()=>{sv.classList.add('out');setTimeout(()=>{si=(si+1)%S.length;draw();sv.classList.remove('out')},350)},4200);
</script></body></html>
